limpar-planilha.descricao_pagina: Remove duplicate and empty rows, trim spaces and standardize e-mail in a CSV or Excel spreadsheet. Everything runs in your browser.
limpar-planilha.resumo: Upload a CSV or Excel file, choose what counts as a duplicate and download a clean copy. The original file is never changed.

revisar.nota_local: Nothing is written now. The original spreadsheet stays untouched — the download is a new file.

exportar.texto: Choose the format of the new file. The original stays where it was, with no change at all.

como_usar.um: Upload the CSV, XLSX or XLS file. It is read in your browser and never leaves your device.
como_usar.dois: Tick the columns that define a duplicate row (e-mail, for example) and choose which row stays when there is a repeat.
como_usar.tres: Review the preview with what stays and what goes before exporting — nothing is written until you download.
como_usar.quatro: Download the new file as CSV or XLSX. The original file stays exactly as it was.

original.resposta: No. The cleanup creates a new file to download; the file you uploaded is never modified and never leaves your browser.

criterio.pergunta: How does the tool decide which row is the duplicate?
criterio.resposta: Two rows are treated as the same when the values of the ticked columns match, ignoring upper and lower case and spaces at the ends. You choose which of the two stays: the first, the most recent or the most complete.

limite.resposta: The uploaded file can be up to 20 MB. Bigger spreadsheets need to be split first.
